summary.name: Google Flow Music
summary.one_liner: Google Flow Music is a generative AI platform for creating, remixing, and sharing full-length songs, with options to direct music videos and build custom music tools.
use_cases: generate full-length songs from text prompts
make AI music videos with Veo
build custom audio plugins or music games
share and publish songs with followers
create playlists and discover new music
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a studio-style interface where users chat with a "Producer" to create full-length songs with vocals, powered by the Lyria 3.5 music model. It offers an AI music video feature that uses Google's Veo video model, letting users control characters, aesthetics, and details. A "Vibe-code" feature lets users build things such as audio plugins, music games, or custom DAWs in code. Users can also create playlists, publish songs, follow artists, and receive personalized recommendations that adapt to their style over time.
notable: Chat with Producer interface for creating full-length songs with vocals
Vibe-code feature for building audio plugins, games, and DAWs
Learns user style to personalize output over time
caveats: Page says 'Free to start' with no credit card required, implying paid tiers may exist but none are detailed
Page text is mostly marketing; specific limits, pricing tiers and song quotas are not stated
Listing describes it under the Riffusion name, but the page content is for Google Flow Music, so the link may have changed
